just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gs4 and dwells most on F# in Hesar, Pt. 3. The line peaks at Gs4 (415.4 Hz) at 0:39.9. It closes on F#4, not the tonic (Gs4 → Gs4 → Gs4 → F#4 → F#4 → F#4).
